dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and relatively symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a subtle localized convexity on the right edge mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between subtle variations in grey tones across the dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One prominent, high-contrast light-colored oval mark on the right dorsal flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, light-colored circular/oval mark, likely a scar or lesion, is visible on the right side of the dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, linear white highlight is present along the central longitudinal dorsal ridge.
